name: Mini Spinach Rolls
blurb: Spinach, ricotta and feta rolled in our own butter puff.
description: Our best-selling savoury. English spinach cooked down with ricotta and Danish feta, seasoned with nutmeg and cracked pepper, then rolled in the laminated puff pastry we make from scratch every second day. Baked to a deep gold with a shattering crust.
storage: Best eaten the day of purchase. Refresh in a 180°C oven for 8 minutes.

name: Party Pastry Platter
blurb: Our full savoury range on one board — 36 pieces.
description: A mixed board of everything the cabinet does best: party pies, sausage rolls, spinach rolls, cheese and bacon scrolls and mini quiches. Arrives on a timber board ready to serve, or boxed if you'd rather plate it yourself.
storage: Serve within 2 hours of collection, or refrigerate and refresh at 180°C.

name: Party Pies
blurb: Slow-cooked beef in a short crust base with puff lid.
description: Chuck beef braised for four hours with thyme and a splash of stout, thickened and cooled overnight before it goes anywhere near pastry. Short crust base, puff lid, glossy egg wash.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days. Reheat at 180°C for 12 minutes.

name: Classic Sausage Rolls
blurb: Pork and fennel, wrapped in butter puff, sesame top.
description: Coarse-ground pork shoulder with toasted fennel seed, sage and a little apple for sweetness. Hand-rolled, scored, and finished with sesame. Nothing in the mix but meat, herbs and seasoning.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days. Reheat at 180°C for 12 minutes.

name: Mini Quiche Selection
blurb: Three fillings — lorraine, mushroom, and pumpkin feta.
description: Buttery short crust shells blind-baked, then filled with a proper set custard — cream, whole egg and nothing else holding it together. Four each of bacon lorraine, field mushroom and thyme, and roast pumpkin with feta.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days. Serve at room temperature or gently warmed.

name: Butter Croissants
blurb: Three days of lamination. Worth every hour of it.
description: Cultured French butter folded through a slow-fermented dough over three days, giving an open honeycomb crumb and a crust that flakes the moment you touch it. We bake these to order every morning and they sell out most days by ten.
storage: Eat the day of baking. Revive at 170°C for 5 minutes.

name: Almond Croissants
blurb: Yesterday's croissants, soaked and filled with frangipane.
description: The traditional second bake. Day-old croissants soaked in rum syrup, split and filled with almond frangipane, topped with flaked almonds and baked again until the filling caramelises at the edges. Dusted with icing sugar.
storage: Best the day of baking. Keeps 2 days in an airtight container.

name: Danish Fruit Selection
blurb: Apricot, custard, cherry and apple cinnamon.
description: Laminated danish dough piped with vanilla bean crème pâtissière and topped with fruit — two each of apricot, plain custard, morello cherry, and apple cinnamon. Finished with apricot glaze and fondant drizzle.
storage: Best the day of baking. Store covered at room temperature.

name: Cinnamon Scrolls
blurb: Deep cinnamon butter, cream cheese glaze.
description: Enriched dough rolled with a thick cinnamon butter, proved slow and baked close together so the sides stay soft and the tops catch. Cream cheese glaze goes on while they're still warm so it sinks in.
storage: Keeps 2 days at room temperature. Warm briefly before serving.

name: Chocolate Éclairs
blurb: Choux shells, vanilla crème, dark chocolate fondant.
description: Piped choux baked until properly dry so the shells hold their shape, filled with vanilla bean crème pâtissière and dipped in 55% dark chocolate fondant. We fill these to order — never in advance — so the shell stays crisp.
storage: Eat the day of purchase. Refrigerate if holding more than 4 hours.

name: Coffee Éclairs
blurb: Espresso crème and coffee fondant, toasted hazelnut.
description: The same choux shell, filled with crème pâtissière spiked with a double shot of our house espresso, glazed in coffee fondant and finished with chopped toasted hazelnut.
storage: Eat the day of purchase. Refrigerate if holding more than 4 hours.

name: Mini Éclair Box
blurb: Bite-sized éclairs in six flavours, boxed for a crowd.
description: Eighteen finger-sized éclairs — three each of chocolate, coffee, vanilla, salted caramel, raspberry and pistachio. Presented in a windowed gift box, which makes them a very easy thing to arrive holding.
storage: Refrigerate and serve within 24 hours.

name: Lemon Meringue Tarts
blurb: Sharp lemon curd, torched Italian meringue.
description: Sweet pastry shells filled with a curd made from whole lemons — juice and zest — cooked slowly with butter and egg yolk so it sets without gelatine. Topped with Italian meringue and torched to order.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days. Bring to room temperature before serving.

name: Portuguese Tarts
blurb: Blistered tops, cinnamon custard, shatter-crisp base.
description: Baked hot and fast so the tops blister the way they should. Cinnamon and lemon-infused custard in a flaky laminated shell, out of the oven in small batches through the day.
storage: Best within hours of baking. Do not refrigerate — it softens the base.

name: Mini Cheesecakes
blurb: Baked vanilla cheesecake, three fruit toppings.
description: Proper baked cheesecake on a digestive base — dense, not fluffy — in individual portions. Three each of passionfruit, salted caramel and mixed berry compote.
storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days.

name: Friand Selection
blurb: Almond and brown butter — naturally gluten free.
description: Almond meal, egg white and browned butter, which is what gives friands their nutty edge. No flour anywhere in the recipe. Four raspberry and four lemon pistachio.
storage: Keeps 3 days in an airtight container.

name: Sourdough Loaf
blurb: 48-hour ferment, blistered crust, open crumb.
description: Stoneground flour, water, salt and a starter we've kept going since the shop opened. Two days of cold fermentation gives it the sour note and keeping quality. Baked on stone with steam.
storage: Cut side down on a board for 3 days. Freezes well sliced.

name: Soft Dinner Rolls
blurb: Pillowy milk rolls, brushed with butter out of the oven.
description: An enriched milk dough, proved twice and baked in a tray so they tear apart at the seams. Brushed with melted butter the moment they come out. The standard order for every roast dinner in the district.
storage: Best same day. Warm briefly to refresh.

name: Celebration Cake — 6 inch
blurb: Choose your sponge, filling and finish. Serves 8–10.
description: A two-tier six inch cake built to your spec. Pick the sponge (vanilla bean, dark chocolate, red velvet or lemon), the filling (Swiss meringue buttercream, chocolate ganache, fresh cream and berries, or salted caramel) and the finish (smooth buttercream, semi-naked, or drip). Message piped free of charge — add it in the order notes.
storage: Refrigerate. Remove 2 hours before serving so the buttercream softens.

name: Celebration Cake — 8 inch
blurb: The party size. Same choices, serves 16–20.
description: Our eight inch build, three layers deep. Same sponge, filling and finish choices as the six inch, with room for a proper message and candles. Popular for milestone birthdays and engagements.
storage: Refrigerate. Remove 2 hours before serving.

name: Morning Tea Box
blurb: Sweet and savoury, boxed for the office. Feeds 10–12.
description: The order most of the business parks around here put in on a Friday. Twelve savoury pieces — mini quiches, spinach rolls and scrolls — and twelve sweet — danishes, friands and mini tarts. Napkins and serving tongs included.
storage: Serve within 4 hours of collection.

name: Sweet Grazing Board
blurb: A full dessert table on one board. Feeds 20.
description: Mini éclairs, tarts, friands, brownie squares, macarons and fresh seasonal fruit, arranged on a large timber board. We deliver it set up and collect the board the next day.
storage: Serve within 4 hours. Keep out of direct sun.
